entries.name: ◇SKILLS
entries.purpose: AGENT DOSSIER > SKILLS tab — the capabilities granted by the objects at this agent’s workstation, shown as a perk grid with a "GRANTED — N LIVE" header.
entries.promise: The "N LIVE" count equals the run-path grant: a perk is LIVE iff its cap is null (the always-on compute freebie) OR its cap object is placed at the workstation (World.heroCaps). N == the count of .perk.on tiles == what composeOffice actually grants — never a decorative number.
entries.notes: Re-proof @ 0a009ec2: con-tab-agents-skills present in the 5-tab dossier rail. Ev run1-full.json (agent-chrome tabs).

entries.name: minimum gap between turn-in beats per agent
entries.purpose: Minimum gap (minutes) between reflection turn-in beats per agent — throttles how often memories are proposed.
entries.promise: Entering 0-60 + SAVE POSTs reflectCooldownMs (mins*60000) to /api/memory/config; persists and applies at the reflect gate; out-of-range is rejected client-side.
entries.notes: Re-proof @ 0a009ec2: #mc-cooldown present with a real value (3) in the mission-control reflection block. Ev run1-full.json (mc-reflect cdVal:"3").

entries.name: input
entries.purpose: Master on/off for station reflection — whether the station proposes memories after a completed task (consent-gated).
entries.promise: Toggling + SAVE POSTs reflectEnabled to /api/memory/config; the value persists and is honored live at the sidecar reflect gate. Hydrates from GET on open.
entries.notes: Re-proof @ 0a009ec2: #mc-reflect-on present (checkbox) in mission-control. Ev run1-full.json (mc-reflect onType:"checkbox").

entries.name: SAVE
entries.purpose: Persists the reflection on/off + cooldown to the station memory config.
entries.promise: Click validates cooldown (0-60) then POSTs both fields to /api/memory/config; a saved response flips the inline msg to "✓ saved"; a failure shows an honest error, never a false success.
entries.notes: Re-proof @ 0a009ec2: #mc-reflect-save present (SAVE) in mission-control. Ev run1-full.json (mc-reflect saveText:"SAVE").
